what: On first open, scroll is locked and the center logo fills for 1s (fadeIn 2s cut at 1s), then disappears in 1s, after which the pieces of the illustration pile pop in one after another at .5s intervals, growing from .5x and transparent over 1s ease (bounceIn). 1s after the last piece’s turn the headline appears over 2s, and 1s after that scroll is released — once a day (cookie), and at 768px and below or with reduced motion everything is visible from the start

options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Center logo (optional) — placed with absolute position covering the board
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Pieces that pop and grow in sequence (document order). A big title text group also goes in as one piece
options.head: Selector (optional) for headlines hidden together and shown later — to hide them before the page paints, put is-fx-opening on html and hide with that class (the part removes it at the end)
options.fade: Logo and headline fadeIn·fadeOut keyframe length (seconds), default 2
options.pop · from: Length of a single piece (sec) · starting scale, default 1 · .5
options.head-at: Time from the last piece’s turn to the headline (sec), default 1
options.unlock: Seconds until scroll is released after the headline, default 1
options.once: If none, always plays without a cookie (default once a day)
options.narrow: Skipped at this width (px) or below, default 768
